messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert fired for dedicated tenant 'OrchidHealth' on cluster 'dedicated-eu-3'. Metric: io_sched.p95_latency > 800ms across GPU nodes. Error rate up 3x. PagerDuty incident PD-83421. Link: <https://pagerduty.example/PD-83421>

pagerduty-bot: PD-83421 assigned to @emma (on-call). Notify escalation policy 'dedicated-oncall'.

emma: ack. I'm taking this. Quick check: is this isolated to OrchidHealth or cluster-wide?

raj: seeing similar p95 lift for other tenants on same cluster but lower magnitude. OrchidHealth shows tail latency spikes + some io errors in kubelet logs.

morgan: +1, telemetry shows sustained disk io wait on nodes eu3-gpu-[02..05]. Possible underlying host IO saturation.

priya: runbook: dedicated cluster io/backpressure. Steps in runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/inference/iosched-latency (run through cache flush -> disable prefetch -> enable burst-capacity).

emma: running quick checks. `kubectl -n dedicated-eu-3 top nodes` -> CPU ok. `iostat -x` shows util 96% on sda3 on eu3-gpu-03.

emma: taking eu3-gpu-03 out of rotation (drain) to see if tail improves. Command: ```kubectl drain eu3-gpu-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30```

(reacted with :rocket: by raj)

raj: while that drains, flipping routing policy for OrchidHealth to fallback model-variant hosted-lowlatency to avoid customer impact. Command to run: `redwood route update --tenant OrchidHealth --policy fallback=hosted-lowlatency`

diego: ETA on drain?

emma: drain started, pods are terminating. Observability: io_sched.p95 for OrchidHealth already down from 820ms -> 420ms in the last 30s. Error rate dropping.

pagerduty-bot: PD-83421 acknowledged by emma at 1827600012. Escalation paused.

priya: still need to investigate root cause. Uploading kernel and dmesg from eu3-gpu-03 to /tmp/pd-83421-eu3-gpu-03.tar.gz and sharing.

morgan: logs show repeated nvme queue resets. Looks like firmware or host kernel IO scheduling regressions after recent kernel update (k8s-host-5.12.3).

raj: we should open infra-ticket and pin node images until patch. I'll create INFRA-1298 and set priority P1 for impacted dedicated clusters.

emma: customer comms: OrchidHealth impacted — increased inference latency and transient errors. I'll draft quick message for CSM. "We routed traffic to a fallback variant to prevent errors. Engineering is investigating root cause; we'll update in 30m."

diego: thanks. Any chance Orchids see model-quality impact from fallback? It uses hosted-lowlatency which is quantized variant; small latency vs quality tradeoff. CS advised it's acceptable short-term.

priya: mitigation: enable reserved-burst on dedicated-eu-3 for OrchidHealth briefly (30m) to increase headroom while infra patches nodes. Command: `redwood capacity set --tenant OrchidHealth --cluster dedicated-eu-3 --burst=enabled --duration=30m`

emma: done. Activation confirmed. Metrics show stable p95 ~380ms and errors back to baseline. Marking incident as "mitigated" — but keeping PD open until root cause ticket INFRA-1298 assigned + patch ETA.

pagerduty-bot: PD-83421 status: mitigated (acknowledged) by emma at 1827600120.

raj: INFRA-1298 created and assigned to infra-lead (morgan). ETA for kernel rollback or patch: ~4 hours.

morgan: starting postmortem draft. Initial notes: suspected nvme firmware/kernel IO regression. Affected nodes: eu3-gpu-03, eu3-gpu-04; actionables: 1) revert kernel on pool, 2) coordinate firmware vendor, 3) add io saturation alert to earlier threshold (p95 > 400ms).

emma: handing off to daytime on-call @raj at 08:00 UTC for follow-ups. I'll update customer thread and mark myself as secondary.

raj: taking over. I'll monitor and follow INFRA-1298. Thanks all. (reacted with :white_check_mark:)

emma: resolved for now. Final note: keep PD open until infra confirms patch scheduling.

pagerduty-bot: PD-83421 remains open. Last activity at 1827600220.
